Suggested activities to add to team-building-activities.docx:

Activity 5: Virtual Escape Room Challenge
- Description: A digital team escape room experience where teams must solve puzzles and work together to "escape" within a time limit. Can be conducted remotely or in-office.
- Objective: To enhance collaborative problem-solving, communication under pressure, and team cohesion in a fun, low-stress environment.
- Location: Virtual or Conference Room B
- Date: Flexible scheduling (1.5-2 hours)
- Time: Afternoon sessions recommended

Activity 6: Team Volunteering Day
- Description: A community service day where team members volunteer together at a local charity, food bank, or community organization. Teams rotate through different stations to maximize impact.
- Objective: To build teamwork through shared purpose, strengthen bonds outside the office setting, and contribute positively to the community.
- Location: Local community organization (e.g., food bank, habitat for humanity)
- Date: Quarterly
- Time: Full day (08:00 - 16:00)
